title: CRM Pipeline Digest — scheduled workflow recipe
description: Ready-to-import recipe for the NV oOS Pro Workflow Builder + Pro Schedule Manager: runs get_pipeline_digest and forwards the digest text to a messaging channel. No code changes required — apply via the MCP tools and adjust the delivery node's credentials for your site.
notes: Deliver via WhatsApp instead: swap deliver.tool_name to send_whatsapp_message and provide access_token/phone_number_id/to.
On sites without Telegram/WhatsApp credentials, change deliver.tool_name to create_document or a paper_store tool to persist the digest locally.
Stalled-deal detection uses the stage_changed_at anchor (stage-history ledger); legacy deals fall back to post_modified.
Apply the workflow through the Pro Workflow Builder UI (or its install_preset/tool endpoints), then create the schedule with create_pro_schedule pointing at the workflow.
